title: Local cohomological bound property for a class of module sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small relative to the coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention], with its actual covering families [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of rings. For a class $\mathcal H$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the local bound property means that there exists a set $\mathcal V\subseteq\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ such that every site object has a covering by members of $\mathcal V$, and every $V\in\mathcal V$ has an integer $d_V$ and a cofinal collection of covering families $\{V_i\to V\}$ such that $H^p(V_i,F)=0$ for all $p\geq0$ with $p>d_V$ and all $F\in\mathcal H$. Here $H^p$ is right derived sections of the underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Cofinal means that each covering family has a refinement in this collection: every arrow of the refining family factors through a member of the original family.
